notes.title: Update 1.01: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers!

We'd like to send out a quick thank you to players everywhere for sharing their feedback on the game and bugs they've come across so far. We appreciate the time you've taken to help us make TOHU a better experience for everyone 🙂 We've been hard at work on a patch to fix these issues and are rolling out the first one today.

Detailed patch notes below:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where certain languages were not displaying special characters correctly
[*] Fixed rare issue where vine puzzle pieces became stuck on screen
[*] Fixed an issue which caused the game to freeze on the Ice Fish
[*] Fixed an issue in Location 4 which caused The Girl to teleport
[*] Fixed a rare soft lock issue in the Pirate Cove
[*] Fixed an issue causing the wrong font to appear on the vine puzzle
[*] Fixed an issue which caused the Broker to chase the dog infinitely
[*] Implemented a number of other minor bug fixes and tweaks

[*] Tentatively fixed a very rare issue where characters would not load in after saving the game
[/list]

notes.title: TOHU Is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey there fellow adventurers!

The big day is here! TOHU is out now and ready for you to get wrapped up in 👾 To celebrate this occasion, we’ve put together a Launch Trailer we hope you’ll enjoy!

[previewyoutube=X7U0--Za0A8;full][/previewyoutube]

If you’re wondering what it’s all about, TOHU is a wholesome adventure game set amongst a world of weird and wonderful fish planets. You’ll explore beautiful environments and solve intricate puzzles as a little girl, joined by her mechanical alter-ego, Cubus. Together you will discover the truth about yourselves and the mysterious Sacred Engine that powers your world.

What are you waiting for? Put on your explorer’s cap, whip out the puzzle-solving-smarts and prepare for an enchanting journey through an off-beat fishy planet universe! 🌌

If you enjoy TOHU, please consider leaving a review on the Steam Store page. We’ve done our best to ensure the game is as bug-free as possible but if you do happen to encounter any issues on your adventures, please drop us a line in the forums and we’ll take a look!

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Autumn + Steam Festival = Gaming Time!
notes.content:
Hey there Steam Game Festival-goers!

Whip out your warmest gaming attire and pumpkin-flavoured beverages and GET COMFY! Autumn is here and it’s gaming time 🍁 We’re excited to bring TOHU’s free playable demo back for the Autumn Edition of the Steam Game Festival and hope you’ll give the game a go before it launches later on this year.

TOHU’s demo will be available to play for the duration of the festival from 7 - 13 October so if you’d like a preview of what’s to come ahead of launch later this year, then brandish your puzzle solving skills and DIG IN 👾

[b]What does the demo cover?[/b]

⭐ The first location in a brand new adventure game.
⭐ Play as both the Little Girl and her mechanical alter-ego, Cubus.
⭐ A touch of puzzle-solving.
⭐ 3 critters to find and add to your collection.
⭐ A chill and magical soundtrack composed by none other than Christopher Larkin himself.

[b]What can you expect in the full game?[/b]

⭐ [b]Experience A Brand New Adventure Game Set Amongst the Weird and Wonderful Fish Planets[/b] - Explore beautiful environments and solve intricate puzzles as a little girl, joined by her mechanical alter-ego, Cubus. Together they will discover the truth about themselves and the mysterious Sacred Engine that powers their world.

⭐ [b]Adventure As A Little Girl[/b] - Explore vivid and atmospheric locations, meet intriguing characters, and solve elaborate puzzles - all on your quest to repair the Sacred Engine. As The Girl you are light and nimble, and so can reach areas of the world that others can't.

⭐ [b]Utilise the Might of Cubus[/b] - At any time you can transform into The Girl’s mechanical friend, Cubus. Need something heavy lifting? Need big strong arms to catch lightbulb flies as they pass by? Need to win an impromptu arm wrestle with an arcane and somehow tangible mirror image of yourself? Cubus has you covered.

⭐ [b]Discover Gorgeous Handcrafted Worlds[/b] - Each fish planet in TOHU is brought to life through bewitchingly beautiful artwork and is packed with detail. Meet a cast of bizarre characters and uncover cute critters to collect!

⭐ [b]Solve Intricately Crafted Puzzles[/b] - You'll need your wits about you to solve TOHU’s unique and wacky conundrums. From a simple search for critters needed to power your expanse-traversing fly-ship, to learning how to operate a moustache-imbuing mole cannon.

⭐ [b]Bathe In An Entrancing Soundscape[/b] - TOHU also features a musical score by Christopher Larkin, the award winning composer responsible for the soundtrack of Hollow Knight.

If you have any thoughts or suggestions, feel free to drop us a line in Steam's Discussions :)

If you enjoyed playing TOHU's demo, please remember to wishlist the game by clicking on the handy widget below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1075200/TOHU/

If you’d like to keep up with TOHU’s development and check out our art, illustrations, and other cool bits and bobs, follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/fireartgames/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Fireartgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/fireartgames/]Instagram[/url] & [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCKp0znC7Q1gekJGmdPtiw3Q]YouTube[/url]!

If you'd like to know more about Fireart Games and what we do, you can visit our website [url=https://fireart.games/]here[/url].

notes.title: Fireart Friday Q&A #6
notes.content:
Greetings and happy Friday everyone!

Welcome to our 6th entry (*phew*!) in the #FireartFriday series! This week, we meet a different kind of wizard - A code wizard 👾 The name's Bahinskyi. Vladyslav Bahinskyi 😎

Being a Programmer, he has a hand in a number of cool features in TOHU, including puzzles, like this beauty:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35001661/17e8fe171ace7fd4316381fb83eb8762b02abc18.jpg[/img]

[b]What do you do at Fireart Games?[/b]
I'm a Lead Programmer.

[b]What is your favourite thing about TOHU?[/b]
My favourite thing is definitely the art style.

[b]What did you do before working on TOHU?[/b]
I programmed a bunch of other games! 🙂

[b]What do you like to get up to when you're not working?[/b]
My favourite bands are FFDP, Disturbed, Architects, In This Moment, Eisbrecher, and In Extremo (there was a time in my life when I knew some German language 😃), so I like attending rock/metal concerts 🤘 Before quarantine kicked in, I went to an FFDP and Megadeth concert in Warsaw which was really cool!

[b]What's your favourite video game of ALL time?[/b]
I can't name JUST one, but the short list would be: Portal, Mass Effect 1 & 2, StarCraft, and EVE Online.

notes.title: Fireart Friday Q&A #5
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to another round of #FireartFriday! Today we'd like to introduce another one of TOHU's artistic wizards (aka Illustrators), Dzmitry Kazak 🧙

TOHU's teaser trailer was based on his illustration for the game 🖌️ Check it out!

[previewyoutube=CcU8iMJ2Xvc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What do you do at Fireart Games?[/b]
I'm one of the two Illustrators on the team. Sometimes, I also take part in solving game design issues, working on small animations, and discussing game-related questions. I took part in most of the game shows and exhibitions where we were presenting TOHU.

[b]What is your favourite thing about TOHU?[/b]
It is definitely the art style and graphics! The visual part of the game that includes great animations created by our Animation Team.

[b]What did you do before working on TOHU?[/b]
I took part in the production of our first game, Spirit Roots, as an Illustrator, Concept and Environment Artist and, sometimes, Level Designer.

[b]What do you like to get up to when you're not working?[/b]
I spend most of my free time reading books, watching movies or TV shows, and improving my skills with CG tutorials or workshops.

[b]What's your favourite video game of ALL time?[/b]
It's difficult to choose just one, so here's a bunch of games from different genres - Hollow Knight, Quake III, the Witcher series, Fallout 1 & 2, Full Throttle, Machinarium, and many other games which I would definitely put on the same level!

notes.title: Fireart Friday Q&A #4
notes.content:
Bring out your party hats because it's #FireartFriday! 🎉

In our fourth entry in this series, we have a sit-down with Dan Gartman, an Illustrator and Art Director, working on bringing TOHU's world to life 🎨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35001661/e6b1ff72a6b0cd74e308853a393d25a0f173ec2e.png[/img]

[b]What do you do at Fireart Games?[/b]
Primarily, I'm an Illustrator and Art Director. But because we are a small team, I also work on simple animations, styleframes, game design, scripting, narrative design, UX/UI design, etc. 😀 Almost everything except coding!

I'm the bad guy in our team because I tend to criticize and I'm not satisfied with something if it isn't perfect (especially when it comes down to art and animation).

[b]What is your favourite thing about TOHU?[/b]
I love every small creature we created with Dima Kazak. I feel like a God of TOHU's world 😆 And I love each animal on the screen. My favourite creature is a glowworm (it has a small lamp, you can see it in the main menu) because this is the first creature I worked on before TOHU was even imagined as a game. It's something important and symbolic for me.

[b]What did you do before working on TOHU?[/b]
I did the same things that I do now - Illustrations, concepts, my own visual novel game, art pictures, and playing bass guitar.

[b]What do you like to get up to when you're not working?[/b]
I'm a big pet father (I have a cat, a dog, and a guinea pig)! I also have a small amateur sound studio at home where I produce music (live jamming, playing bass guitar, and synths). I'm a big fan of tabletop games and I'm a Dungeon Master (RPG, D&D).

[b]What's your favourite video game of ALL time?[/b]
I have 3 options 🙂

What I love to play - Dota2
What I love as the best game of human civilization - Minecraft
What I love as art - Stardew Valley

If you'd like to learn more about Fireart Games, you can check them out right [url=https://fireart.games/]here[/url] or wishlist TOHU by clicking on the handy widget below!

notes.title: Fireart Friday Q&A #3
notes.content:
Happy #FireartFriday everyone!

Time to sit around the proverbial campfire 🔥, roast some marshmallows, and get to know Olga Tesliuk, one of the final pieces of TOHU's Animation Team. Say hello! 👋🏻

Let's kick this off with a funky animation straight from Olga herself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35001661/4efdfbad221d3a6b57233530027a51082e36693c.gif[/img]

[b]What do you do at Fireart Games?[/b]
At Fireart Games, I work on character animations, from main characters to little beings in the background.

[b]What is your favourite thing about TOHU?[/b]
My favourite thing about TOHU is to see how all the different results of team work come together to create a beautiful piece of art.

[b]What did you do before working on TOHU?[/b]
I worked as a Freelance Motion Designer and made a student game with my friends. Because of the experience I gained, I was able to join the TOHU team.

[b]What do you like to get up to when you're not working?[/b]
When I'm not working on TOHU, I work on my own projects 😄 But when I want to relax, I play games, watch TV series, hang out with friends - Just normal stuff.

[b]What's your favourite video game of ALL time?[/b]
It's hard to choose, there are lots of genres with great games! But maybe I'll choose Ori and the Blind Forest, as it is a big inspiration for me.

notes.title: Fireart Friday Q&A #2
notes.content:
Happy Friday, TOHU wishlisters!

In this week's edition of #FireartFriday, we get to know a little more about another Animator behind the magic of TOHU ✨ - Alex Ionoff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35001661/41ad6b227e989b199ccdb13c2b7246a9e40dc45d.jpg[/img]

[b]What do you do at Fireart Games?[/b]
Animation!

[b]What is your favourite thing about TOHU?[/b]
I really like point and click games, like Machinarium and I think that TOHU will combine the best features of this genre. Great music, illustrations and, of course, animations 😄

notes.title: Fireart Friday Q&A #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone and happy [i](totally official)[/i] #FireartFriday!

We thought it would be nice to start a weekly blog where we have a sit-down with the team and get to know a little more about the minds behind TOHU.

Today we're meeting TOHU's Animation Lead, Aslan Almukhambetov 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35001661/e1a0ed34905eddd3dd4c1f1cf7953eeaf7eb29ef.jpg[/img]

[b]What do you do at Fireart Games?[/b]
I’m an Animator and Animation Lead at Fireart Games. So besides bringing our beautiful characters to life, I also look after our Animation Team and send them feedback in order to make our animation even better!

[b]What is your favourite thing about TOHU?[/b]
What I like about TOHU is its incredible diversity in visuals and puzzles. The amount of different characters and mechanics is not only going to entertain gamers, but it also entertains me as an Animator, so it’s always interesting to work on anything there!

[b]What did you do before working on TOHU?[/b]
I worked as a Character Animator on our previous game, Spirit Roots, and, for the most part of my career, I was a Motion Designer, but recently I’m leaning more and more towards character animation (both 2D and 3D).

[b]What do you like to get up to when you're not working?[/b]
Usually, after a whole day of animating at work, I continue to animate during my free time. There is not much stuff left to do during the quarantine, so 😄

[b]What's your favourite video game of ALL time?[/b]
Oh, that’s a tough one. I’m in love with recent platformers, such as Celeste or Gris. For the last 5 years, I was mostly playing Dota 2. But my all time favourite would be Team Fortress 2, for sure. There is no other game that I’ve played as much as I played TF2. I mean 1700 hours on Steam is a lot 😆
